Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for anyone who feels loneliest inside their own house.

She: Jesus... my family loves me, but they don't understand me. 💔
She: Amma asks why I'm quiet lately. I keep giving her half the story.
She: But hiding it all is lonely. Even a full house can feel empty.
Jesus: She raised you. Some weights you hide to protect her, not to deceive her.
Jesus: Then let Me fill the room you don't show anyone. I understand you fully.
Jesus: You're not unloved at that table. You're just known best somewhere else.
